author: CasaOS Team
description: Swing Music is a beautifully designed, self-hosted music streaming server. Like a cooler Spotify ... but bring your own music.
tagline: Swing Music is a beautifully designed, self-hosted music streaming server. Like a cooler Spotify ... but bring your own music.

tips.before_install:
When you first start Swing Music, it will ask you to pick music directory: Where do you want to look for music?
select "Specific directories" Option, and select "/music" and rescan.
